description: This file defines the internal class 'GrainLifecycle' within the Orleans.Runtime namespace. It manages grain lifecycle stages and migration participants, providing methods to add, remove, and retrieve migration participants, as well as to get stage names based on stage identifiers.

classes.name: GrainLifecycle
classes.description: An internal class managing grain lifecycle stages and migration participants within Orleans runtime.

methods.name: GetMigrationParticipants
methods.description: Returns the collection of current grain migration participants.

methods.name: AddMigrationParticipant
methods.description: Adds a new grain migration participant to the lifecycle.

methods.name: RemoveMigrationParticipant
methods.description: Removes a specified grain migration participant from the lifecycle.

methods.name: GetStageName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a lifecycle stage based on its integer identifier.
